title: Sum Of Subarray Minimums
description:
For every non-empty contiguous subarray of `arr`, take its minimum value. Return the sum of these minima modulo `10^9 + 7`.

## Examples

```text
Input: arr = [3, 1, 2, 4]
Output: 17
```

```text
Input: arr = [11, 81, 94, 43, 3]
Output: 444
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= arr.length <= 3 * 10^4`
- `1 <= arr[i] <= 3 * 10^4`
